topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 70 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 15 common project-authored base contract(s) (dsmath, dsauth, dsauthevents). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
